summary.en: Use the **past perfect** for an action that happened **before** another moment or action in the past: _When I got to the station, the train had left._ It makes the order of events clear. If events are told in the order they happened, the past simple is enough.
summary.es: Corresponde al pluscuamperfecto («había salido»). Se usa para la acción anterior cuando hay dos momentos en el pasado. No hace falta si cuentas los hechos en orden cronológico.

form: Negative: **hadn't** + past participle. Question: **Had** + subject + past participle?

uses.text: **The earlier of two past actions** → _By the time we arrived, the film **had started**._
**Reasons for a past situation** → _He was upset because he **had failed** the test._
**Reported experiences** → _She said she **had never travelled** abroad before._
**After the time word** → _After she **had finished** her degree, she moved to Madrid._

note.en: When one action clearly follows the other with _after_ or _before_, the past simple is also common: _After she finished…_
note.es: Con after/before también es habitual el past simple si el orden es evidente.

uses.text: **Third conditional and wishes about the past** → _If I **had known**, I would have called._

mistakes.wrong: When I arrived, the shop already closed.
mistakes.right: When I arrived, the shop had already closed.

why.en: The shop closed before I arrived, so the earlier action needs the past perfect.
why.es: El cierre fue anterior a mi llegada: past perfect.

mistakes.wrong: I had visited Rome last year.

why.en: With a single past event and no earlier reference point, use the past simple.
why.es: Si no hay otro momento pasado de referencia, usa past simple.

mistakes.wrong: She told me she has lost her passport.
mistakes.right: She told me she had lost her passport.

why.en: After a past reporting verb, the earlier event moves back to the past perfect.
why.es: Tras un verbo en pasado, la acción anterior pasa a past perfect.

examples.en: By the time the manager called, I had already left the office.
examples.es: Cuando llamó el jefe, yo ya había salido de la oficina.

examples.en: She was nervous because she had never flown before.
examples.es: Estaba nerviosa porque nunca había volado.

examples.en: They hadn't booked a hotel, so they slept in the car.
Had you met him before the conference?
I realised that I had left my umbrella on the train.
After we had eaten, we went for a walk along the river.
He didn't get the job because he hadn't prepared properly.
The fields were flooded. It had rained for three days.
Until that evening, I had never tried Thai food.

practice.prompt: When we got to the cinema, the film ___ .

explanation.en: The film started before we arrived: past perfect.

practice.prompt: I was tired because I ___ much the night before.

explanation.en: Not sleeping came before being tired, so use the past perfect.

practice.prompt: She ___ in Paris in 2018, then she moved to Berlin.

explanation.en: No earlier reference point is needed; the events are in order: past simple.

practice.prompt: He said he ___ the report, so I didn't send mine.

explanation.en: Reported earlier action after a past verb: past perfect.
